topic_title: Campaign Alpha revision — purpose to exploratory judgement
cmp_edition: IFoA CS1 Core Reading / CMP · 2026 syllabus alignment

mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to protect memory of Campaign Alpha — retrieving the purpose map, an aim-linked EDA tool choice, and one disciplined association interpretation — so first-pass gains do not evaporate before Chapter 2.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will run closed-book retrieval across the three Learning days' hinges, not a re-read of CMP chapters — so revision is assessable return, not empty 'review yesterday' theatre.
mission.educational_intent: Produce retrieval strength on the Campaign Educational Objective: purposeful analysis → exploratory judgement → honest association limits.
mission.learning_objective: Retrieve and connect (1) analysis aims and reproducibility, (2) an aim-linked summary-and-plot choice, and (3) a justified correlation-measure choice with one non-claim.
mission.concept_focus: Campaign chain retrieval: purpose → EDA tools → association limits.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday you finished association measures under 1.2.2 without overclaiming. Today is Revision mode: return to Days 1–3 skills under closed-book retrieval — no new first-pass LO.
mission.why_now: After purpose-to-EDA, spaced retrieval now protects that opening chain before the distributional chapter begins.
mission.expected_benefit: Evidence that the Campaign chain still retrieves — Study Progress on revision, not a claim that Chapter 1 is mastered or that PCA is done.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Alpha Revision because Architecture §9.2 requires memory return inside the Pilot Arc; return targets are 1.1, 1.2.1, and 1.2.2 skills taught earlier in this Campaign.
success_criteria: Closed-book, restate the three analysis aims and one reproducibility element.
Defend one summary-and-plot pair for a stated aim and variable type.
Choose among Pearson/Spearman/Kendall for a stated situation and refuse one overclaim.
task_descriptions: Without opening the CMP, sketch the Campaign chain on one page: purpose → tools → association.
Complete the Revision Knowledge Checks under closed-book rules.
Author a revision Reflection that names the weakest link in the chain for spaced return later.

session.session_educational_purpose: This Revision Session exists to retrieve and connect Campaign Alpha skills under closed-book conditions — not to teach PCA or open Chapter 2.
session.session_tutor_purpose: In this sitting I will keep the CMP closed for checks, run three retrieval items across the Campaign hinges, and harvest the weakest link — Gate RV substance, not chrome.
session.wrap_up: Revision Session complete for Retrieve the purpose-to-EDA chain. You stress-tested Campaign Alpha return targets (1.1 purpose map, 1.2.1 tool judgement, 1.2.2 association limits). This is revision Study Progress — not Topic Complete for PCA (1.2.3), and not the start of distributions (2.1).
session.confidence_prompt: How confident are you that the purpose → EDA → association chain will still retrieve in three days? Rate 1–5 and name the weakest link as your warrant.

reading_guidance.lead_line: Purpose of this revision stage: strengthen retrieval of the Campaign Alpha chain (purpose map → summaries/visualisations → correlation measures) without opening a new CMP chapter first. Attempt closed-book retrieval; only then, if a check fails, reopen the exact failed locus.
focus_questions: Can you restate aims → stages → sources → reproducibility without notes?
Can you defend one summary-and-plot pair for a stated aim?
Can you choose a correlation measure and refuse an overclaim?
misconception_watch: Watch for turning revision into a passive re-read of Chapter 1.
Watch for skipping association limits because 'we already did correlation yesterday.'
Watch for claiming Chapter 1 complete including PCA.
reading_guidance.open_point: No new CMP open required to begin. Targeted re-open only after failed retrieval: Day 1 purpose block, Day 2 1.2.1 block, or Day 3 1.2.2 block as needed.
reading_guidance.stop_condition: After the three revision checks and Reflection — do not begin Syllabus 1.2.3 or 2.1 in this sitting
reading_guidance.annotation_task: Before checks: sketch purpose → tools → association on one page from memory
reading_guidance.attempt_before_reveal: All revision checks are attempt-first; CMP re-open only after a failed item
reading_guidance.exit_line: Keep the CMP closed to begin. Kwalitec directs revision; the CMP is reopened only as a targeted instrument after a failed retrieval — not as a fresh chapter read and not as a substitute for the checks. Sketch the Campaign chain from memory, then begin the revision Knowledge Checks. If a check fails, reopen only Day 1 purpose / Day 2 1.2.1 / Day 3 1.2.2 locus for that item, then close again. Do not begin Syllabus 1.2.3 or 2.1 in this sitting. Immediate next activity after this guidance: revision Knowledge Checks (retrieval).
reading_guidance.return_cue: You are finished with the reading-guidance stage when you have kept the CMP closed and are ready to start revision checks. Immediate next activity: revision Knowledge Checks. Return to the CMP only if a specific check fails, at that item's locus only.
reading_guidance.reentry_line: If you reopened the CMP for one failed item, close it again. Immediate next activity: continue revision Knowledge Checks — do not restart Chapter 1.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Recall: purpose map
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Restate the three primary aims of data analysis with one short example each, and name one reproducibility element.
hints: Reproducibility: versioned data, scripted path, documentation, seed…
knowledge_checks.explanation: Revision succeeds only if Day 1 purpose language still retrieves.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Descriptive / inferential / predictive with distinct examples; plus e.g. versioned dataset and scripted analysis path.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Listing EDA tools instead of aims.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Checkpoint: EDA tool judgement
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Aim = descriptive; variable = right-skewed claim size. Defend one summary and one visualisation; name one misuse you refuse.
hints: Median/IQR or shape-aware reporting; histogram/boxplot; refuse pie or mean-only theatre.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Revision must reconnect aim to tool choice.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Median (IQR) + histogram/boxplot for skew; refuse mean-only or pie-chart summary of continuous magnitude.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Default mean with no shape warrant.

knowledge_checks.title: Revision Checkpoint: association limits
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Skewed variables, outliers, monotone but nonlinear scatter. Choose Pearson, Spearman, or Kendall and justify. State one claim the coefficient does not support.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Spearman or Kendall for monotone nonlinear association with outliers; coefficient does not prove causation.

reflection.framing: Revision Reflection names the weakest Campaign link for future spaced return — not a chapter summary.
reflection.prompt: Which Campaign link retrieved least cleanly today — purpose map, EDA tool judgement, or association limits — and what one concrete rework will you schedule? Do not claim PCA or Chapter 2 complete.
prompts: Which Campaign link retrieved least cleanly — purpose map, EDA tool judgement, or association limits?
What one concrete rework will you schedule for that link?
Confirm: PCA (1.2.3) and distributions (2.1) were out of scope today.
